caption:
Storm season. You're harnessed on a roof, and the phone's ringing in your pocket where you can't reach it.
That caller has water coming in. Leave them hanging and they might ring the next roofer on the list.
TradeReach texts each missed caller back within moments, asks single or double storey and for photos taken from the ground, and flags storm leaks to you straight away.
👉 See how it works at tradereach.net
